_comment: This file lists ONLY records that were created as test data. Anything not
listed here is never touched — there is no wipe mode.
1. Give this cleanup run a unique label; you must repeat it as --confirm.
2. List the test resident emails. Each one must match a test pattern
(@example.com, @*.invalid, test*, *_test@, +test@, demo@, qa@, ci@) or the
3. residents.testPeriods is REQUIRED: the academic term codes that are known
to contain only test data. If a matched resident has journal rows outside
these periods, the script refuses to delete them — that is a real resident.
4. firestore lists the exact document IDs to remove. Get them from the app's
image URL (/api/image/<docId>) or the Firestore console.
label: replace-with-a-unique-run-label-e.g.-testrun-2026-05-01
_allowNonTestEmails_comment: Set to true ONLY if a test account has a real-looking email address. Every
time you do this, record here why. Leave false in normal operation.
